Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service

Class ResearchSynthesisService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service.ResearchSynthesisService
public class ResearchSynthesisService extends Object
Domain service that converts a set of RetrievedSource documents and a ResearchPlan into a structured ResearchAnswer by calling the AI model with a synthesis prompt.

The synthesis prompt instructs the model to organise its response into 2-3 thematic sections, each introduced by a ## Markdown heading and containing inline citation markers ([1], [2], …). This service then parses those headings to split the raw AI response into individual ResearchSection records.

When the AI response contains no ## headings the entire response is placed in a single section titled "Research Findings".

The synthesis prompt template is loaded at construction time via PromptLoaderService and injected through AppConfig. Placeholders substituted: {query}, {sources}.

      public ResearchAnswer synthesize(String query, ResearchPlan plan, List<RetrievedSource> sources, List<SourceCitation> citations)
      Synthesize a ResearchAnswer from the retrieved sources and research plan.
      Parameters:
      query - The original research question.
      plan - The research plan used to retrieve sources (used for context).
